crossRefs.note: God said to him in the dream, “Yes, I know that in the integrity of your heart you have done this, and I also withheld…
“Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!”
So is he who goes in to his neighbor’s wife. Whoever touches her will not be unpunished.
For Yahweh of Armies says: ‘For honor he has sent me to the nations which plundered you; for he who touches you touches…

people.name: Abimelech
people.line: Philistine king who interacted with Abraham and Isaac

translations.web: Abimelech commanded all the people, saying, “He who touches this man or his wife will surely be put to death.”
translations.bsb: So Abimelech warned all the people, saying, “Whoever harms this man or his wife will surely be put to death.”
translations.kjv: And Abimelech charged all his people, saying, He that toucheth this man or his wife shall surely be put to death.
translations.asv: And Abimelech charged all the people, saying, He that toucheth this man or his wife shall surely be put to death.
